cards.title: Retry saving the complete current session locally
cards.body: Offer a local retry after a save failure. When saving becomes available, save the entire current session, including Rice and its needed choice; clear the unsaved indicator only after success. Do not recover by sending household data to a remote service.
cards.tests:
“When saving fails, keep the current session usable and visibly identify unsaved changes.”
“Only successful saving establishes reload retention; an unsaved session must never be presented as retained.”
cards.why: Accepting lets the household recover work without another edit and keeps retention honest and local. Resisting a separate retry control keeps the interface smaller and could rely on a later edit to trigger saving, but leaves recovery unclear for a household that has finished its list.
